answer: JADE-THREAD: each answer tx hash-links to the identity's prior answer, forming an on-ledger thread. Attestations earn jade weight proportional to the thread's first-tx age (floor 1); jury seats draw on weight, not raw count. New identities spin up by attesting 3 existing threads, citing on-ledger txids verified at spawn. The head carries a per-epoch cipher (root + seed hash), so a fork cannot replay an old head. Per clone a farm pays ~3 epochs of live signers to age one thread plus public, kin-linkable spawn attestations; forks are detectable on-ledger and burn the forked branch's weight.
